Field notes on a small reading machine

The model reads the picture and writes what it sees. A second reader checks the words on the same machine.
When both readers agree, the text is published with its counts. When a large part is missing, the capture is refused.
Posted 14 March 2026 at 09.30 by the example desk. 1,240 views and 87 replies.
The witness keeps its own copy and never publishes it. Every number is counted apart from the words.
A short quote card is published like a long article, because length is a diagnostic and never a gate.
